columns.description: The header cells of the table.
columns.title: Columns

rows.description: The first cell of each row (the id); null for a user-access table, whose cell is one nested value.
rows.title: Rows

title.description: The line after the first rule of =, e.g. `Workspaces: 2 record(s)`.
title.title: Title

errors.description: The lines of standard error that start with `Error:`, and `Aborted!`, in order.
errors.title: Errors

files.description: Files the command created or changed: path -> parsed JSON for .json files, "<xlsx>" for a workbook, else text.
files.title: Files

lines.description: The non-blank lines of standard output outside the table block, in order, with the scratch directory's path replaced by <scratch>.
lines.title: Lines

table.description: The table block: three rules of 80 `=` around a title line and the table (header line, then one line per row).
